title: 2022 Brazilian general election
summary: The English Wikipedia article "2022 Brazilian general election", at revision 1375252300, opens: "General elections were held in Brazil on 2 October 2022 to elect the president, vice president, the National Congress, the governors, vice governors and legislative assemblies of all federative units, and the district council of Fernando de Noronha. As no candidate for president received more than half of the valid votes in the first round, a runoff election for these offices was held on 30 October. Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva received the majority of the votes in the second round and was elected president of Brazil for a third, non-consecutive term." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q65053343, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "general election held in Brazil". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
